summary: Gonka Broker gives every account a monthly free tier sized as 1M tokens of its most expensive model, so cheaper models yield more (about 1M for MiniMax M2, about 1.2M each for DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM-5.3-Flash, about 6M for BGE-M3). The allowance renews on the 1st of each calendar month; unused tokens expire. Free-tier requests are rate-limited for fair use. No credit card is needed; beyond the free tier, usage is prepaid per token in USD and free tokens are consumed before any paid balance.
claim_steps: Sign up with email or Google
Create an API key in the dashboard
Call the OpenAI-compatible API; the free tier renews on the 1st of each month
